name: Mail
description: Lists, searches, reads, marks, moves and labels mail, drafts or sends email - as HTML made from the text by default, or as plain text with format: text - and watches a folder for new mail, over an IMAP app-password mailbox, Microsoft or Google. Drafts only by default; sends only to a person's allowlist; never deletes.

mode.description: draft saves a draft the person sends from their mailbox and never sends anything; send sends, and only to addresses on sendAllowlist.

format.description: html sends the body as written plus an HTML version made from it (Markdown: headings, bold, lists, links; HTML tags in the body are shown as text, never used); text sends plain text only.

sendAllowlist.description: Who it may draft to or send to: full addresses (person+tag@example.com) or whole domains (@example.com). Case is ignored; a +tag must match exactly as written. Every To, Cc and Bcc recipient must be on it, in draft mode too.

markRead.description: Lets mark-read and mark-unread change whether a message is read. Off: both are refused.

moveTo.description: The only folders and labels move and label may use (Archive, Receipts). Empty: move and label are refused. Nothing is ever deleted.

maxResults.description: The most messages one command reads: list and search (a max:<n> may only lower it), the ids one mark, move or label takes, and the new messages one watch check takes.

maxBodyChars.description: read cuts a message's body to this many characters and says it was cut.

watchFolder.description: The folder watch checks for new mail.

watchUnreadOnly.description: watch lists only new mail that is still unread.

watchSenders.description: When set, watch lists only mail whose sender contains one of these (an address or @example.com).

watchQuery.description: When set, watch lists only mail matching it: from:<text>, subject:<text>, and words that must appear in the sender, subject or snippet.

watchLookbackDays.description: How many days back the first check lists mail that is already there. 0: the watch starts from now.

mailbox.description: The mailbox to read, draft and send from: an IMAP app password (Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo, other), a Microsoft account or a Google account.

publishes.summary: One check of the watch found new mail, or mail nobody acknowledged yet: every such message, never a body.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: How many messages the event lists.

fields.name: ids
fields.summary: Their ids, comma-separated, as ack takes them.

fields.name: messages
fields.summary: Each message: id, thread, from, subject, date, a short snippet, and listed (how many checks have listed it).

fields.name: more
fields.summary: How many more did not fit in this event; the next check lists them.
